subject: Social Media
title: How a Tweet Becomes a Storm
description: A fast breakdown of How a Tweet Becomes a Storm for builders.

hook.text: Justine Sacco tweeted a bad joke to 170 followers. She boarded a plane. She landed to a ruined life.

buildup.text: Her tweet was screenshotted, shared with outrage, and amplified by thousands. Context vanished fast.

discovery.text: Pile-ons follow a pattern: trigger, outrage, influencer boost, mass pile-on, then silence after the fall.

twist.text: Most people spent seconds on the outrage. Sacco spent years recovering. The asymmetry is staggering.

climax.text: Her case became Jon Ronson's book. The mob had moved on. She was still rebuilding her entire life.

punchline.text: The internet moved on. She couldn't.

quiz.question: What pattern do online pile-ons follow?
options: Trigger, outrage, amplification, mass attack, silence
